name: Ancient Lorekeeper
summary: (Elf Only) The ancient lorekeeper is a repository for all the beliefs and vast knowledge of an elven people.
replacesText: Mystery Bonus Skills; Mystery Bonus Spells

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: An ancient lorekeeper adds Knowledge (arcane) and Knowledge (local) to her list of class skills. Whenever she makes a Knowledge check of any kind about a question regarding elves (creatures of the elf subtype), the ancient lorekeeper adds half her class level on her check. This replaces the bonus skills the ancient lorekeeper gains from her mystery.

features.name: Elven Arcana (Ex)
features.summary: Choose a Sorcerer/Wizard spell at least one spell level below your Oracle casting cap at this milestone. You learn it as an Oracle bonus spell one level higher than its printed Sorcerer/Wizard level. This replaces mystery bonus spells.

features.name: Mysteries
features.summary: The following oracle mysteries complement the ancient lorekeeper archetype: Lore, Nature, Waves, Wind; Ancestor, Time, Wood.
